rules.why: both arms reaching past the head toward the ball
body close to horizontal, side-on to the shooter

text.action: a soccer goalkeeper diving to the right at full stretch to save a shot
text.core: Body airborne and nearly horizontal, lying on its right side, chest facing the shooter; both arms straight and reaching past the head toward the ball, lower hand behind the ball and top hand over it, gloves open with fingers spread; left push-off leg trailing with the knee bent, right leg extended below; head in line with the arms.
text.gaze: Eyes locked on the ball between the gloves.
cues: push off from the near-side leg
body side-on, not facing the ground
hands lead, fingers spread behind and on top of the ball
head stays in line and watches the ball into the hands
kinetic: body frozen mid-flight above the turf
grass and water spray thrown up by the push-off
ball spinning into the gloves, motion blur on the ball's path

sources.cite: General goalkeeper diving cues (push off the near leg, side-on body, hands lead); kinematics: Sci Rep 2024 penalty dive study (values not retrieved)
